summary: Full backend + UI testing of Laravel Bali Vision Tour app at http://localhost:3000. Backend pytest suite: 41/41 passed (public pages, filter query strings, /booking, /newsletter, admin login/wrong-pw/unauth redirect, all admin pages 200, admin tour CRUD, settings update+restore, content save no-op, preferences, upload, logout). UI (Playwright) verified: booking dialog opens & POSTs /booking -> 201 {ok:true,id}, newsletter footer POST /newsletter -> 200 {ok:true}, admin login redirect to /admin works, wrong-password shows 'Invalid username or password', all admin pages render (bookings, settings, content, account, cars, activities, articles, tours/create, tours/{id}/edit), create tour via UI (title 'QA UI Tour' + price on 'Pricing & Media' tab) succeeds and appears on public /tour-packages, delete via UI removes it (DB count verified = 0), logout form returns to /admin/login. No JS console errors captured.

minor.issue: If a settings payload omits the entire brand/contact/social groups, PHP formerly emitted 'Undefined array key' (log line 289). Current code uses `?? []` so is safe with empty groups but validation still requires contact.whatsapp/contact.email/brand.name/brand.title/brand.logoMode; forms must always submit them all — flag: consider defaulting missing groups more defensively.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminController::updateSettings validation requires brand.name/title/logoMode + contact.whatsapp/email — any client sending a partial payload gets 422; acceptable for admin form which renders all fields, but if any programmatic PUT is planned, add defaults.
SiteController::booking accepts arbitrary 'type' and 'item_name' strings without cross-check against real records — low risk for a WhatsApp-driven flow but flag for future authz/lookup.
Booking dialog client-side requires `date` before POST (line 42, booking-dialog.blade.php); test must set date. Fine.
Storage of settings/blocks in DB via Setting::updateOrCreate — cached via `site()`? Not verified; changes propagate immediately on the / homepage (verified with brand rename test).
seed_data_creation: Newsletter subscribers: qa_test@example.com, qa_ui@example.com. Bookings: 3 test bookings via /booking. All are non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Booking dialog requires clicking [data-testid=book-tour-btn] then filling booking-name/booking-phone/booking-date and clicking booking-submit. Admin resource create modal has tabs: switch via [data-testid=tab-pricing-media] to reach price field. Admin form submit button texts: 'Create Tour Package', 'Simpan', etc. Use JS click to avoid drawer viewport issues in Playwright.
